data.text: Thanks for lunch, Luke—that’s generous, but I’d rather keep the lake healthy and give everyone, including you, an equal share. My family has fished here for generations, and our village depends on it. If we each take 10 tons, we’ll earn $10,000 apiece, leave 50 tons, and start next month back at 100. We can repeat that every month without needing a lean month to recover. I propose a 50-ton total cap, split equally, with a check-in after each harvest. John, would you support 10 tons each instead?
